fields.summary: CVE-2026-78676 rhoai/odh-workbench-jupyter-minimal-cpu-py312-rhel9: GitPython before 3.1.59 Remote Code Execution via Config Injection [rhoai-3.5]

Security Tracking Issue

GitPython before 3.1.59 fails to safely re-serialize multi-line git-config values during write operations.
